title: Projects tab opens with all project folders expanded by default
body:
John 2026-07-28 (main Anchor dashboard · Projects tile/tab):

I do not want to have all of the project folders open when we open the Projects tab on the main Anchor page. That should not be the case.

What happens:
- Open the main Anchor page Projects tile (id=tile-projects).
- Every R&D project folder (group) is expanded — full project rows visible for all folders.
- Only folders the user previously collapsed stay collapsed (localStorage opt-in collapse).
- First visit / cleared storage / new folders → everything open → noisy.

Expected:
- Opening Projects shows folder headers (name + count) collapsed by default.
- User expands only the folder(s) they care about.
- Optional: remember last expand/collapse per folder (already partially exists) but DEFAULT must be collapsed, not expanded.

Code (today):
- Server HTML always emits expanded folders (caret ▾, no rnd-collapsed) in _render_group_folders.
- Client rndFolderInit only adds rnd-collapsed when group name is in localStorage key anchor_rnd_folder_collapsed (list of collapsed groups) — opt-in collapse, default expand.

Success criteria for sleep:
1. Fresh load / empty localStorage: all project folders collapsed on Projects open.
2. User can expand one folder without all others opening.
3. If we keep persistence: remember expands (or collapses) honestly; never default-open-all.
4. No flash of fully expanded content before JS if server-side default is collapsed.
